name: ai-atenea-one
description: Read-only Atenea One plugin: MCP tools to search networks, devices and servers, plus the atenea-one skill.

interface.shortDescription: Look up Atenea One networks, devices and servers (read-only).
interface.longDescription: Read-only access to an Atenea One control plane through a service token: search the inventory, read resources and verify reachability with ping, TCP, SSH banner and DNS probes against inventory devices only.
defaultPrompt: Which servers are online in my Atenea One networks?
Find the device with a given name or IP and check that it answers.
